assessment_basis: Prospective strict-interior selection from an existing manually reviewed packet; three explicit separate-reader assignments; independent source reconstruction and integer-sum verification.
reason: All retained forms admit positive weights from the28-value table when different working signs may share a value. This is necessary arithmetic capacity only, not a identified sign mapping, complete writer, language or meaning.

blockers.detail: No independently fixed injective/homophonic alphabet choice, source-word framing, packet-choice law or explanation of native distribution/direction. Feasible witnesses alone cannot select any of these.

all_of.detail: A separately motivated explicit human contract and decision-changing falsifier; retain existing feasibility and do not claim it has already provided a decoder.

not_sufficient: A solver witness relabelled as native values
Automatic changes to framing or atomization
Treating alternate readers as independent manuscripts
